name: mcp.getaltera.com
description:
Altera imports and exports Shopify store data with Excel and CSV files. Use this connector to export data from your store, build an import file, check what the import will change, and apply it. You can also use it manage your store's files.

## What you can do

- Export products, orders, customers, collections, discounts, pages, blog posts, and redirects. Filter by tag, vendor, status, date range, or other supported fields.
- Create an import file from an export, from your own spreadsheet, or from a description of the change.
- Update prices, inventory, tags, SEO fields, metafields, product categories, and sales channel publishing in bulk, including per-variant publishing.
- Create products, customers, orders, and collections in bulk. Upload images and files as part of the import.
- Look up field references, export filters, metafield definitions and metaobject definitions, markets, locations, and the Shopify product taxonomy.
- Check job status, download result files, and open Shopify admin links to verify the result.

## Supported data types

In addition to the data types that other spreadsheet apps support, Altera imports and exports metafield definitions, metaobject definitions, catalogs, locations, inventory transfers, and translations for every translatable resource, including market-specific translations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.getaltera.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.getaltera.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getaltera.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.getaltera.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.getaltera.com lists 27 MCP tools, including export_create, import_create, job_cancel, job_download_url, job_run, job_status, list_jobs, list_shops, read_doc, ref_fields, ref_filters, and ref_metafields.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.getaltera.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.getaltera.com in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
mcp.getaltera.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.getaltera.com is developed by Altera. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
